description: Normalized Trino 476 query lifecycle record contract. Native event payloads are mapped by audit/normalize.py.
limitations: Query events do not enumerate all patients returned.
Output rows do not prove the client viewed the result.
Trino event SPI JSON serialization is unstable across versions; revalidate against the pinned release before upgrading.
Policy version/digest are not native event fields and must be supplied by the collector.

field_semantics.query_text_restricted: Always store [REDACTED] when native metadata.query is present; never persist raw SQL, deterministic SQL hashes, literals, failure messages, stack traces, plans, client addresses, or arbitrary session properties.
field_semantics.policy_version: Caller-supplied from the policy version active when the event was observed; null when unavailable.
field_semantics.policy_digest: Caller-supplied digest of the active policy; null when unavailable.
field_semantics.output_rows_if_available: QueryCompleted statistics.outputRows when it is a non-negative integer; null for QueryCreated or when unavailable.
field_semantics.event_timestamp: QueryCreated createTime or QueryCompleted endTime, normalized to UTC ISO-8601.
field_semantics.received_timestamp: Collector/normalizer receive time supplied by caller or current UTC time.

trino_476_mapping.QueryCompleted: metadata, statistics, context, ioMetadata, failureInfo, createTime, endTime
trino_476_mapping.error_code: failureInfo.errorCode.name; failure text and serialized stack traces are intentionally discarded
